name: binofit
expr: [ph_s, pci_s] = binofit(k, n); [ph_v, pci_v] = binofit(xV, nV); [ph_z, pci_z] = binofit(0, 10); [ph_f, pci_f] = binofit(10, 10); [ph_a, pci_a] = binofit(k, n, 0.01);
comment: Sig: [phat, pci] = binofit(x, n[, alpha]). Clopper-Pearson exact binomial CI. Covers: scalar (k=7,n=10), vector ([3 5 7]'), edges x=0 + x=n, non-default alpha=0.01. No 'Method' kw — MATLAB binofit hard-codes Clopper-Pearson.
